notes:
- Point your agent at your Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox or iCloud Drive folder on this
  computer. Pick several folders at once, and leave out any you'd rather it didn't search.
- Turn on Read my files first in Email Manager or Text Replies, and before your agent writes to
  someone you've written to, it reads the files that name them. The card says which files it read,
  and nothing goes out until you press Send.
- Tell your agent "When Dr. Miller emails, text me", and each time she writes it sends you one
  message saying who wrote and what about. Noticing her email and telling you uses none of your AI.
- A statement laid out like one your agent read before goes on a card by itself. Archie reads
  the lines, makes sure they add up to the totals printed on it, and uses none of your AI.
- Press Confirm or just say yes under a change your agent is waiting on, and Archie makes the
  change right away, without asking the AI.
- The Knowledge tab is simpler. Notes and file descriptions open in a box that shows all of
  them, and memory notes look like cards, as they do in Archie Mobile.
- Setting up your AI account puts the key box first, and a key you paste while the box is showing
  goes into it. Drop a picture of your key and Archie tells you how to copy the key instead.
- The rest of the orange words you press now look like buttons, across the app, and What it can
  do says how many of its switches are on.
- Fixed: a picture dropped outside the conversation was offered to your documents and then refused.
  Archie now says to drop it on the conversation.
- Fixed: a note your agent kept in memory could start with its own thinking.
